snippet.title: Crimson Desert - Release Date Reveal Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10002363

The fight for Pywel begins March 19, 2026. Pre-order Crimson Desert now on the PlayStation Store and let a new chapter of this land's history begin.

(This gameplay trailer contains actual in-game footage captured on PlayStation 5 Pro. As a work-in-progress, the content is subject to change.)
 
About Crimson Desert
Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game developed by Pearl Abyss. 
A devastating ambush in the deep of night by their sworn enemies the Black Bears leaves members of the Greymanes dead or scattered across the continent. 
The Greymane Kliff is determined to reunite with his surviving comrades and rebuild what was lost. But on a journey where alliances are forged, dangers abound, and mysterious factions are uncovered, Kliff comes to realize that an unprecedented threat and a destiny greater than he imagined await him.

Reach beyond and experience the world of Crimson Desert on March 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5.
 
May contain content inappropriate for children. Visit http://www.esrb.org for rating information.
